title: COE bidding results, every round since 2010
description: Every Certificate of Entitlement bidding round since January 2010, category by category: the quota premium, quota, bids received and successful, the premium in today's dollars, and the Prevailing Quota Premium for the next month.
question: What did each COE category close at in every bidding round since 2010?

row.is: One category in one bidding round

fields.name: month
fields.meaning: The month of the bidding exercise.

fields.name: round
fields.meaning: The round in that month: 1 or 2.

fields.name: closing_date
fields.meaning: The day bidding closed; from January 2024.

fields.name: category
fields.meaning: COE category: A (smaller cars), B (larger cars), C (goods vehicles and buses), D (motorcycles), E (open).

fields.name: quota_premium_sgd
fields.meaning: The quota premium: what every successful bidder in the category pays.

fields.name: quota
fields.meaning: How many COEs were on offer.

fields.name: successful_bids
fields.meaning: How many bids won a COE.

fields.name: premium_in_latest_cpi_month_sgd
fields.unit: S$, in the prices of the month named in the CSV header
fields.meaning: The quota premium in today's money, using SingStat's CPI for the latest month; the month is in the CSV column's name.

fields.name: pqp_for_next_month_sgd
fields.meaning: The Prevailing Quota Premium for renewing a COE next month: the mean of the last six rounds' premiums, rounded up. Given on each month's second round for categories A to D, from March 2010.
